# Security policy

## Report a vulnerability

Report it privately. Do not open a public issue.

Go to the [Security tab](https://github.com/lupinum-dev/ginko/security) of this repository and choose
**Report a vulnerability**. This opens a private advisory that only the maintainers can see.

Please include the affected package and version, what an attacker can do, and steps to reproduce.

We answer within 3 working days. We fix confirmed issues through a patch release and publish an
advisory with the fixed version. We credit you if you want.

## Scope

In scope:

- The seven public packages: `@lupinum/ginko`, `@lupinum/ginko-i18n`, `@lupinum/ginko-content`,
  `@lupinum/ginko-components`, `@lupinum/ginko-docs`, `@lupinum/ginko-preset-gastro` and `create-ginko`.
- The hosted Ginko platform run by Lupinum.

Out of scope: the demo sites in this repository, and problems that need a modified or already
compromised environment.

We support the latest released version of each package.

There is no bug bounty.
